agentLine.text: Using an AI agent? Point it at getff.ai/llms.txt

oneCommand.heading: One command
oneCommand.body: Run it from your project root. It copies the rules, wires the git hooks and CI, and asks before it touches your dependencies. Once they are installed, it proves that a rule fires.

plugin.heading: Or start with the Claude Code plugin
plugin.body: The plugin gives your agent skills, helper agents, and session hooks. It never touches your git hooks or CI. Run the installer when you want rules that fail the build.

handWritten: The executable AGENTS.md you can open today is this repository's own. Generating one for your project is on the roadmap, not shipped.
